purpose: Explicit bounded disposition of the four formerly open numerical-source gaps; no fictional scores, no automatic harvesting.

harnessrank.denominator: 89 tasks; three or five runs per historical harness
harnessrank.reason: Four original aggregates for Pi, OMP, OpenCode and Codex are retained with cost/token/score fields. The models/harness versions are historical and excluded from direct current routing selection.

databricks.reason: Public article gives qualitative conclusions and graphical comparisons; verified complete model-harness numeric records, task denominators and uncertainty are not available in the frozen text capture. Do not digitize figures as exact measurements or infer privately held task scores.
databricks.requiredToClose: Verifiable author-published machine-readable model-by-harness results, or exact table with denominators and conditions.

webarena.reason: Publisher documents a benchmark with 812 verified tasks and a 258-task hard subset. Dataset size and task counts are benchmark metadata, not a model success rate. No current model-by-harness run scores are present in the frozen captured source.
webarena.requiredToClose: Publisher result artifact with harness/model/effort/version and evaluated successes; never normalize dataset cardinality as model capability.

bixbench.reason: Publisher links raw trajectory and evaluation tables. The evaluation CSV advertised a 1,075,070,319-byte response during the 2026-10-12 review; the download was intentionally aborted by an explicit size bound. Captured paper HTML contains a dataset-comparison table, not verified model scores. Code license does not automatically settle redistribution rights for the evaluation table.
bixbench.requiredToClose: Publisher-approved, size-bounded, versioned aggregate extraction or smaller authoritative numerical table with task/sample denominator, output hashes, and rights review.

generalRule: A source can be discovered and captured but not normalized; unknown metric kind, source identity or benchmark protocol does not become zero or a ranked model score.
